fullDescription: Easy to convert ordinary digital tyre inflator to digital nitrogen tyre inflator using this module. Reliable PSA method for nitrogen generation with 95-99% purity suitable for vehicle nitrogen inflation. Air and nitrogen input pressure option available in single machine. The nitrogen generator uses Pressure Swing Adsorption (PSA) Technology for reliable and cost-efficient nitrogen generation. It comes with computer power chord adapter with fuse protection and switch on indicator, pressure switch for automatic nitrogen generation cut-off, pressure gauge for input air pressure indication and internal tank nitrogen pressure indication, safety pressure relief valve available for internal tank, and wheel base option is available to move to desired location.
